test_two.limitation_note: the statistic keys on the LEADING eigenvector, so an eigenvalue reordering that promotes a minor axis trips it (angle ~pi/2) though the eigenvector set is unchanged

verdict: BOTH TESTS EXECUTABLE AND SPECIFIC, and the declared limit reproduced. Test Two fires on a genuine eigenframe rotation (0.60 rad) and is silent on a heavy-tailed surge (0.00) and a pure rescaling (0.00) -- the specificity §15.4 asserts, now checked. Multivariate IAAFT is calibrated (rejects the linear-noise null in only 5% of linear-VAR repeats) and powered (rejects in 100% of nonlinear repeats). Crucially it reproduces §12.3's honest limit: the Lorenz chaotic generator ALSO rejects the null (100%), confirming the filter kills only the linear-stochastic null -- a nonlinear-but-non-boundary system passes. The §12 abstract claims are therefore backed by an executable, specific instrument, with the eliminative scope the paper already concedes. Syntactic-consistency only; no biological claim.
